units.source_text: 然而，邀真一来清水寺，难道就是为了作这番表白？

en.t: Yet had she invited Shinichi to Kiyomizu Temple simply to make this confession?

units.source_text: 千重子的声音比往常更加纯真、清朗，里面蕴藏着一股美好而坚强的力量，仿佛不像是对真一倾诉自己的衷肠。

en.t: Chieko's voice was more innocent and clear than usual, with a beautiful, strong power hidden within it, as though she were not pouring out her heart to Shinichi at all.
